title: What Mercy for a Brother's Failure and War on His Own Sin Looks Like
caption:
Most guys have it backwards. Soft on their own sin, sharp with everyone else's.

A godly man flips it. He's the harshest critic of his own excuses and the gentlest hand when a brother's falling apart, because he remembers exactly what that felt like.

Jesus named the plank in your own eye before you go looking for the speck in his. You're not qualified to touch someone else's failure until you've dealt honestly with your own.

Where are you harder on him than you are on yourself?

theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
